contract: docs/v3/concepts/skills-agent-layer.md section 6 (invariants table; 25-27 are lint tests carried by the gr rows, 9-11 and 21-24 dropped on purpose) and section 8 (Invariants row). Verbs and flags: src/cli/index.ts as the skeleton left it.

commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: bun test of the folder exits 0 with the failing registrations counted.
acceptance: For each N in 1-8, 12-16, 31-35, 39, 40 a test title starts 'inv N:', plus 'inv x-versions:' and 'inv x-snippets:' (an rg loop pasted in the PR)
